summary.text: Katie O'Brien Duzan is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing unopposed from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Katie O'Brien Duzan was born in Arlington, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree in theater and an MBA in management and marketing from Texas Christian University's Neeley School of Business.
Her career experience includes working as a business manager and marketing executive, and she has been affiliated with the Arlington ISD Citizens Bond Oversight Committee.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she attended Arlington public schools, is raising two children in public schools, is married to an Air Force veteran, and has led global marketing teams for a decade.
In the survey, O'Brien Duzan said her key messages include lowering costs for Texas families, fully funding public schools and opposing the state's school voucher program.
She faces Republican Cheryl Bean in the general election for a seat with no incumbent.
